summary: PCB Bancorp filed an 8-K covering first-quarter 2026 earnings, a quarterly cash dividend of $0.22 per share declared April 22, 2026, payable May 15, 2026, and an investor presentation. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is present; the filing is a routine earnings and dividend announcement. The board declared the dividend without any mention of strategic review, activist campaign, or change of control. The items reported are standard operating and financial disclosure items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01. No deal terms or advisors are applicable. There are no risk-arb or activist angles; investors should monitor ongoing quarterly performance and dividend consistency.
